shm.text: Shadowmoor is what Lorwyn becomes after the Great Aurora, turning a constantly sunny world into one of perpetual night.
The Aurora transforms Nibb and Gyik from mischief-makers into feral marauders and makes the kithkin furtive and paranoid, turning their clachans into douns.

In the stories told there, no sun rises and a few brave heroes fight the world for a last glimmer of light, while the plane later fuses with Lorwyn as the Pendulum Year begins and pockets of Lorwyn sprout in Shadowmoor.
